about: Signed Statements for trying a Transparency Service's registration checks. Test keys only.

vectors.change: none: tagged COSE_Sign1, alg -19, kid, CWT Claims with iss and sub, content type, attached payload, empty unprotected header
vectors.text: RFC 9943 Section 6: every MUST on a Signed Statement is met
vectors.expectation: eligible for registration if authentication succeeds and the service's additional policy requirements are met

vectors.text: RFC 9864 deprecates -8 in favour of the fully specified -19, and does not prohibit it; RFC 9943 does not mandate a particular signature algorithm

vectors.change: the unprotected header carries one member
vectors.text: RFC 9943 Section 6.3: a TS MAY accept it, and the unprotected header MUST be an empty map in what is included in the Statement Sequence
vectors.expectation: if registered, the registered bytes differ from the submitted ones, and the leaf does not cover the member

vectors.change: no tag 18 in front of the COSE_Sign1
vectors.expectation: outside that tagged form; record the service's observed handling without treating normalization as a cited requirement

vectors.change: the CWT Claims carry iss and no sub
vectors.text: RFC 9943 Section 6: the CWT Claims value MUST include iss and sub; Section 6.3 step 2: the TS MUST check the required protected headers

vectors.change: no CWT Claims header (label 15) at all
vectors.text: RFC 9943 Section 6: the protected header MUST include the CWT Claims header parameter

vectors.change: no kid, and no x5t or x5chain
vectors.text: RFC 9943 Section 6: kid MUST be present when neither x5t nor x5chain is present in the protected header

vectors.change: the payload is nil (detached); the signature is over the payload of R01
vectors.text: draft-ietf-scitt-scrapi-11 Section 2.3: a detached payload needs an implementation-specific channel; Section 2.3.3 lists the error "Payload Missing"
vectors.expectation: refused unless the service has such a channel

vectors.change: two additions that go together: a private label (-65537) in the protected header, and crit listing it
vectors.text: RFC 9052 Section 3.1: a label listed in crit that the recipient does not understand is an error
vectors.expectation: refused by a service that does not know the label

vectors.change: the last bit of the signature is flipped
vectors.text: RFC 9943 Section 6.3 step 2: the TS MUST verify the signature of the Signed Statement
vectors.expectation: refused when the service knows the issuer's key (it cannot tell otherwise)

vectors.change: valid, signed with a second test key the service must never be given
vectors.text: RFC 9943 Section 5.1.1.1: a TS MUST authenticate Signed Statements as part of a Registration Policy; Section 6.3 step 2: it MUST verify the signature; Section 6: key discovery is out of scope
vectors.expectation: refused when no authenticated binding to the signing key can be established; keep test key 2 untrusted in this test

vectors.change: kid is a text string instead of a byte string
vectors.text: RFC 9052 Section 3.1 (Table 3) and the CDDL of RFC 9943 Section 6.1: kid is a bstr
vectors.expectation: not a conforming kid; a service that finds the key anyway is lenient

vectors.change: no alg in the protected header
vectors.text: RFC 9943 Section 6.1 makes alg optional; RFC 9052 Sections 3.1 and 10 allow algorithm selection to depend on the application profile or authenticated context. Signature verification remains mandatory under RFC 9943 Section 6.3
vectors.expectation: policy-dependent: ts.isoluce.net's policy requires an explicit supported alg and refuses this vector

vectors.change: iss is the integer 1 instead of a text string
vectors.text: RFC 8392 Section 3.1.1: iss is a StringOrURI

vectors.change: the array of four items has its head on two bytes (0x98 0x04)
vectors.text: The cited sections (RFC 9943 Section 6.3, RFC 9942 Section 5.2.1) do not specify whether a service preserves an otherwise valid non-shortest outer array encoding. RFC 9052 Section 9's minimum-length encoding rule applies to Sig_structure, Enc_structure and MAC_structure
vectors.expectation: if registered, say whether the leaf covers the submitted bytes or a re-framed statement
